părēlĭon , i, n., = παρήλιον,
I.a mock sun, parhelion: “parelia sunt imagines solis in nube spissā et vicinā in modum speculi. Quidam parelion ita definiunt: nubes rotunda et splendida, similisque soli,” Sen. Q. N. 1, 11, 2 : “solent et bina fieri parelia,” id. ib. 1, 13, 1 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
